item.title: [6.8] OmniReasoning: Pushing the Limits of Audio-Visual Joint Reasoning
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Recent advances have enabled unified omni-modal models in understanding audio, vision, and language. However, existing benchmarks, training data, and learning methods largely treat the modalities independently, leaving the capability of audio-visual joint reasoning poorly evaluated and insufficiently elicited. We address this gap with a benchmark, data engine, and learning method.

WHY IT MATTERS

It addresses a clear gap in multimodal AI by introducing a dedicated benchmark and training data engine for audio-visual joint reasoning, moving beyond independent modality processing.
